brief: The canvas displays a dense, intricate network of tangled wires and cables. Luminous data streams flow constantly through this web, pulsating with rhythmic energy. The streams appear to move along all thicknesses of cable and undergo a noticeable cycle of brightness. At every major junction in the tangle, the energy signal visibly brightens and momentarily splinters into distinct secondary streams. All of these animated light patterns change continuously and autonomously on the canvas.

The visualization uses a combination of geometric cables with streaming particles and central junctions that pulse with energy and split into multiple streams. The system operates entirely autonomously with no user input required - streams move continuously along cables, junctions pulse rhythmically, and new streams are generated at random intervals. The visual effect creates an organic, living network that constantly evolves while maintaining a structured, geometric framework of connections.
